body.query: For frequent flyers, compare Sony WH-1000XM5 and Bose QuietComfort Ultra headphones: noise cancelling, comfort, battery, and typical price.

response.answer: Sony WH-1000XM5 and Bose QuietComfort Ultra are both excellent for noise cancelling, but Bose usually has the edge on low-frequency cabin/engine rumble while Sony can be better at handling mid/treble sounds like chatter [1][2]. Comfort is a slight Bose advantage for long flights (softer clamping/plusher fit) [3][2]. Battery favors Sony: SoundGuys measured 31h53m (ANC on) vs Bose 27h37m; other sources rate Sony up to ~30h vs Bose ~24h (less with Immersive Audio) [3][4]. Typical price: MSRP Bose $429 vs Sony $399, with frequent discounts—Sony commonly around $300, Bose around ~$330 (as of the cited reporting) [1].
